name: Nenshou!
source: Players train in real life with the help of childhood friend Mayu Uehara, and progress the story by clearing preset “trials” like performing 50 sit-ups in three minutes. As the story advances you become closer with Mayu, but the trials become more demanding. Clearing the story may take several months of training, but stick with it and you’ll have something to show for in the real world as well!
